name: Volume spike without price reaction ('quiet accumulation')
one_line: Volume >= 3x 20-day mean while daily change < 3%; buy next open, hold 5-60 days. Edge only in crypto.

source.license: no LICENSE file in repo; owner's own repository (owner-provided reference, do not redistribute)

status_in_source: hold ('champion' of branch A, not adopted)
idea: Signal at close of day t when volume[t] >= 3 * mean(volume[t-20..t-1]) and close-to-close change < 3% (upper bound only). Enter at next open, hold N days.

rules.name: time_exit
rules.description: exit after fixed holding bars (20 in portfolio tests)

rationale: Heavy volume with muted price may show absorbed supply (early accumulation).
evidence: Crypto 45-coin portfolio: CAGR 62.4%, MDD 53.4%, Sharpe 1.165 (0.04% fee); with 0.10% fee and funding: 52.0/57.4. 20-day edge about +6pp. Random-entry control passed 3/3.
limitations: stop/take-profit/filters all reduced returns in the source's tests
survivorship bias in the coin list
needs cross-asset portfolio for the reported statistics; single-asset signals are sparse (few trades -> gate TOO_FEW_TRADES risk)

pipeline_fit.notes: Few signals per single asset; trade-count gate (>=30 total, >=10 OOS) may fail. Not a good first choice for BTC only.
